test_policy.notes: SAT/ACT are optional for undergraduate admission (required only for special programs such as the B.S./D.O. in Biological Sciences); scores are considered if sent. SAT/ACT do not count as proof of English proficiency. SAT code 2866, ACT code 2939.

requirements.notes: Apply with the Common App or the SUNY application (SUNY code 46); $50 non-refundable fee. International freshmen need an equivalent secondary school average of 80 (U.S. average) or above, a WES or ECE evaluation (waived only for a few countries), a roughly 250-word essay or the SUNY supplemental application, at least one counselor or teacher recommendation, a bank-issued financial statement and a notarized sponsor letter for the I-20, and immunization records.

deadlines.label: Early Action, recommended date (fall 2027 entry)
deadlines.notes: Domestic first-year page; printed without a year and the page header still says 'Apply for Fall 2026', taken as the fall 2027 cycle. No separate international deadline is published.

deadlines.label: Recommended application date, fall 2027 entry
deadlines.notes: Applications are reviewed on a rolling, first-come basis after the recommended dates until enrollment goals are met; spring entry date is Oct. 15. Printed without a year, taken as fall 2027. International applicants need time for the I-20 and visa, so apply well before March.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Required for international students whose native language is not English; no country-based waiver list is published. Accepted proofs: TOEFL (paper 513, computer 183, iBT 61), IELTS 6.0, iTEP 3.5 or Step EIKEN Grade Pre-1. Duolingo and PTE are not listed. Conditional-admission pathways: ELS Level 112 (English for Academic Purposes), Stony Brook Intensive English Center Level B, a C or higher in a U.S. college English composition course, Nassau Community College LINCC, Fulton-Montgomery Community College ESL, or qualifying CLEP/AP/IB exam scores. SAT/ACT do not count.

english.notes: Internet-based minimum 61 (also 513 paper / 183 computer). The page gives no new 1-6 scale minimum.

cost.notes: Bursar table is per semester; annual figures are twice the printed amounts. Out-of-state/international full-time tuition $9,460 per semester ($7,070 a year for NY residents); mandatory fees $676 per semester (college, activity, athletic, health service, technology, transportation), plus a one-time $100-150 orientation fee. Room and board = Woodlands double $4,445 + Panther's All-Access meal plan $3,225 per semester; the Tuition & Aid page shows $14,990, so confirm. Health insurance not included.

aid.notes: Need-based aid is for U.S. citizens and permanent residents. No scholarship for incoming international students was found; the only international-related award seen is a study-abroad scholarship.

toefl.note: No TOEFL institution code was found on the pages read.

duolingo.note: Duolingo is not among the listed English proofs.

pte.note: PTE is not among the listed English proofs.
